name: design-skills
description: Design-domain skills, five of them: layout-decomposer (read, grade, and design any UI layout on the OUTSIDE-IN x INSIDE-OUT axes, with a four-archetype ASCII-wireframe library), mermaid-decomposer (create, decompose, and grade advanced Mermaid diagrams on the INTENT x RENDER axes, with a verbatim 11-type syntax catalog, a gated M1-M6 rubric, and a mechanized render-check), and component-decomposer (decompose, design, and grade zero-dependency web components on the COMPOSE x REALIZE axes, with a deterministic geometry engine — the (height-glyph)/2 law + XS–2XL ramp — a contract-card linter, and controls/overlays recipes) — the three crossing-axis 'decomposers' — plus color-science (perceptual color: spaces, gamut math, contrast/APCA, harmony, CVD, pigment mixing, with a TypeScript color library + 54 interactive demos) and typography-lettering (type anatomy, classification, metrics, world scripts, and the modern CSS text surface). Skills only — no commands, agents, or MCP. Self-contained.
